reviews.title: Compatible, Runs at Rated Speed (Using XMP Profile)
reviews.comment: Works as expected. Installed in a Ryzen 7 5800G system on an ASROCK ITX B550 Phantom Gaming motherboard. Using XMP Profile, it runs at 3600mHz. Ran memtest and it passed. So far so good!
reviews.author: Les

reviews.title: The ram sticks work to protection
reviews.comment: I have a perfect 32gb of ram in my pc and I still have room to upgrade. Although this particular stick doesn't have rgb on it, it still works.
reviews.author: Natasha
